name: Bludit TinyMCE integration
description: Integrates the bundled TinyMCE HTML editor with CMS toolbars, context menus, code-sample language choices and media insertion hooks.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Bludit JSON stores and global runtime objects
metadata.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.
metadata.license: Bundled TinyMCE: GPL-2.0-or-later per its pinned license.md; bundled DOMPurify retains Apache-2.0/MPL-2.0 notices
metadata.deployment_warning: Root CMS MIT metadata does not replace the bundled editor's license obligations.
